summary: jannikluhn 的通用协议内加密内存池 EIP 合并（EIP-8105），这是 Hegotá 执行层头号候选之一。EF 宣布成立 Platform 团队，改善 L1 与 L2 的关系。spencer-tb 提交 EIP-8037 储备机制澄清。nerolation 的 BAL sidecar EIP 合并。

items.title: 新增 EIP：通用协议内加密内存池
items.note: （jannikluhn）合并，即 Hegotá 头号候选 EIP-8105。
items.title_en: Add EIP: Universal Enshrined Encrypted Mempool
items.note_en: (jannikluhn), merged; it is EIP-8105, a Hegotá headliner candidate.

items.title: EIP-8037：澄清储备机制
items.note: （spencer-tb）提交：修正 EELS 实现中发现的小问题，说明 calldata 下限与退款的交互，明确 refund_counter 是单一不分维度的计数器，EIP-7702 授权退款计入状态 gas。
items.note_en: (spencer-tb), submitted: fixes small issues found while implementing in EELS, documents how the calldata floor interacts with refunds, and clarifies that refund_counter is a single undimensioned counter with EIP-7702 authorization refunds going to state gas.

items.title_en: EF blog: Announcing the Platform Team at EF

summary_en: jannikluhn's Universal Enshrined Encrypted Mempool EIP merged (EIP-8105), one of the Hegotá execution layer headliner candidates.
